# Portproof MCP server

> Proxy traffic by the GB: one prepaid GB balance per organisation, usable on two shared pools, mobile 4G/5G (carrier modems) and residential (opt-in peer devices; a mixed peer network, not residential-only). Pool, country, rotation and session are chosen in the proxy username, so one credential serves everything. The pools are shared: the traffic is never dedicated, private, static or unlimited, and a sticky session prefers the same device but does not reserve it, while the carrier may still change its IP. Countries online now come from list_countries; never state a country count from memory. GB never expire while get_traffic reports validity_days 0. Private mobile ports (dedicated mobile ports: one mobile device reserved for the organisation for a rental term, priced per device and term, separate from the GB balance; the mobile IP can change) are sold while the shop lists them: get_pricing says what is on sale now. This stdio MCP server (npm package @portproof/mcp) exposes the Portproof API (base `PORTPROOF_API_URL` + `/v1`, default https://api.portproof.org; key `PORTPROOF_API_KEY`) as nineteen tools. buy_traffic, buy_port and renew_port pay from the wallet (account credit in euros, separate from the GB balance); the server cannot add funds. SMS numbers and eSIMs are sold in the web shop and through the API (see llms-full.txt) but have no tools here.

## Traffic tools

- get_traffic {} -> GB total / used / left, expiry (validity_days 0 = GB never expire), limits, connection details with the password masked (null unless the key holds ports:write). Key scope ports:read.
- list_countries {} -> devices online now per pool and country, counts only (exit addresses are never listed). Public.
- build_proxy_url { pool, country, rotation, session?, protocol?, reveal_password? } -> username, URL and curl / Python / Node / Playwright snippets; password masked unless reveal_password is true. Key scope ports:write.
- test_connection { rotation, pool?, country? } -> pool defaults to best and country to any; rotation is required. ok, exit IP, latency, error_code; exit_country is normally null (no country check); never report the requested country as the exit country. 6 per minute. Key scope ports:write.
- buy_traffic { gb | trial:true, accept_terms:true, confirm:true, idempotency_key } -> order with gb and cost_cents as the server recorded them. Charges the wallet. The trial's GB and price come from get_pricing (traffic.trial). accept_terms records that the user accepts the terms, the acceptable-use policy and the immediate start of the service. Key scope ports:write.

## Port tools (private mobile ports, rented by term)

- get_pricing {} -> field traffic (per-GB tier table, packages, trial, validity) and field skus (port price table; buy_via ports or cart; Partner network SKUs only while on sale for the caller's organisation). Public.
- search_inventory { country?, carrier? } -> Own network ports per site/carrier with carrier_id, the number free and whether new ones are wait-listed. Partner network ports are not listed here: get_pricing lists them. Public.
- quote { sku, term, quantity } -> unit_cents, discount_pct, total_cents, currency, charged:false; for a Partner network SKU price_cents and shop_url instead, or not_on_sale. Public.
- buy_port { sku, term, carrier_id?, auto_renew?, confirm:true, idempotency_key } -> port, proxy_urls, cost_cents, currency. Every port on sale is bought in the web shop (buy_via "cart" in get_pricing): the answer is purchased:false, charged:false, price_cents and shop_url, or not_on_sale. It rents directly (POST /v1/ports) only for an organisation billed by invoice; an account made through sign-up gets use_cart. Key scope ports:write.
- list_ports { limit?, cursor? } -> compact port summaries (label, network, no credentials), next_cursor. A Partner network port has no site_code. Key scope ports:read.
- get_port { port_id } -> full Port with label, network, credentials (if owned; Partner network ports carry credentials.http and credentials.socks5, which may differ in every field), capabilities, renewal, rotation_url (the Portproof link that rotates the IP) and proxy_urls built from each protocol's own set. Key scope ports:read.
- rotate { port_id, confirm:true, idempotency_key } -> rotated, reason, old_ip4, new_ip4, elapsed_ms and the signed rotation record. Waits up to 180 s in all, following the status link when the first answer is 202; status pending with rotation_id when still running. No charge. Key scope ports:write (ports:read too, to follow a pending rotation).
- set_rotation_schedule { port_id, interval_s (0 = sticky, else 60..86400), confirm:true, idempotency_key } -> rotation_interval_s, sticky. No charge. Key scope ports:write.
- renew_port { port_id, confirm:true, idempotency_key } -> renewed, ends_at, auto_renew, cost_cents, currency. One more term from the wallet. Charges money. Key scope ports:write.
- set_auto_renew { port_id, enabled, confirm:true, idempotency_key } -> auto_renew, ends_at. Off: the port ends at the end of its term. No charge now. Key scope ports:write.
- get_passport { port_id } -> port details (API object passport) with label and network. Never credentials. Key scope ports:read.
- get_receipt { receipt_id } -> rotation record plus signature { verified, key_id, reason, keys_url } checked against <API origin>/.well-known/portproof-keys.json. Key scope ports:read.
- get_usage { port_id, from?, to?, granularity? } -> buckets, totals, data[]. Default granularity hour. Key scope ports:read.
- get_status {} -> platform, sites, carriers, public incidents, support. Public.

## Rules

- buy_traffic, buy_port, renew_port, rotate, set_rotation_schedule and set_auto_renew are refused (error code confirmation_required / idempotency_key_required, no API call made) unless confirm is exactly true and idempotency_key is a non-empty printable string; buy_traffic is also refused (terms_acceptance_required) without accept_terms: true. Ask the user before confirming. A refused purchase stays stored under its key for 24 h, so buy with a new key after fixing the cause. Reuse an idempotency_key only to retry the identical request; the API answers idempotency_conflict (409) when a key is reused for a different purchase.
- cost_cents is present whenever money moved (buy_traffic, buy_port, renew_port). quote never charges.
- Every response is compact JSON in one text block. Errors: {"error":{code,status,title,detail,retry_after?,errors?}} using API problem codes: insufficient_funds, trial_already_used, traffic_not_purchased, no_inventory, use_cart, conflict, port_cooldown (retry_after seconds), rescore_quota, insufficient_scope, unauthorized, not_found, validation_failed, idempotency_conflict, rate_limited; local codes: confirmation_required, idempotency_key_required, terms_acceptance_required, not_on_sale, api_unreachable, timeout, http_error, config_missing (no PORTPROOF_API_KEY), unexpected_response.
- Ids are prefixed ULIDs: prt_ ports, rot_ rotations (rotation records), car_ carriers, ord_ orders.
- Money is integer cents in the currency each object states; get_pricing's currency_note says which prices are not in EUR and how VAT applies. Quote prices from the API, never from memory. Times are ISO 8601 UTC.

## Setup

- Run: npx -y @portproof/mcp (Node.js 20 or newer) with PORTPROOF_API_KEY in the environment. PORTPROOF_API_URL is optional and defaults to https://api.portproof.org.
- Client config: {"mcpServers":{"portproof":{"command":"npx","args":["-y","@portproof/mcp"],"env":{"PORTPROOF_API_KEY":"pk_live_..."}}}}. Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Cursor snippets are in README.md.
- API keys are created in the dashboard at https://portproof.org/app/keys; there is no sandbox, every key acts on the real balance.
- No account yet: POST https://api.portproof.org/v1/auth/signup {email, password} creates one and sets the pp_session and pp_csrf cookies; then GET /v1/projects and POST /v1/projects/{id}/keys {"scopes": ["ports:read", "ports:write", "billing:read"]} with the session cookie and X-CSRF-Token set to the pp_csrf value (the secret is shown once). Confirming the email address later revokes every key made before it, so make the key after confirming, or make a new one.
- Funds: buy_traffic and renew_port spend the wallet; insufficient_funds (402) means it is too low. A person adds funds in the dashboard (https://portproof.org/app/wallet) or on the payment page that POST /v1/wallet/topup returns; an agent cannot pay. GB bought on the website go to the GB balance, not the wallet.
- GB are bought at https://portproof.org/proxies and private mobile ports at https://portproof.org/dedicated-mobile-proxies; pay by card or in cryptocurrency.
- Full API reference for LLMs: https://portproof.org/llms-full.txt; OpenAPI document: https://api.portproof.org/docs/json; Swagger page: https://api.portproof.org/docs.
- Guides: https://portproof.org/guides/proxy-mcp-server-for-ai-agents and https://portproof.org/docs#mcp. Release mirror: https://github.com/portproofas/portproof-mcp.
